editorial.blurb: This beloved Japanese izakaya delivers pristine sashimi and perfectly crispy katsu with the kind of attentive service that makes you feel genuinely welcomed.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation, especially for weekends—the intimate tables fill quickly, and the bar seating offers the best vibe for watching the kitchen work.

topDishes.note: Crispy, savory, and incredibly satisfying comfort food
Buttery and perfectly cooked with arugula salad
